summary: Ecommerce derived metrics must be gated by reusable confidence checks and supported child-CLI schema metadata.
reason: Forecast output can mislead when source coverage, freshness, sample size, tracking, or child schema evidence is thin, so a regen must refuse Low/Broken confidence and skip products instead of fabricating estimates.
validated_outcome: go test ./... covers confidence output, Low/Broken refusal, and schema-versioned child sync fixtures.
